rationale: No existing Logs spec exercises the frontend 'stream not found' filter-error path ([data-test='logs-search-filter-error-message']); the selector is only referenced inside logsPage.js wait helpers, never asserted. The behavior is pinned by a Vitest unit spec (SearchBar.streamNotFound.spec.ts) but has zero E2E coverage. It is a single, self-contained Logs feature, so a new spec in Logs/ (registered under the Logs-Core ci_matrix group) is the correct shape — not an append to an unrelated quickmode/queries spec.
